{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins.groupby('species', observed=True)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the full result to capture exact values
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Identify the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}')"}
